summary: The proposed patch attempts to address the issue of overriding `get_FOO_display()` by ensuring that the method is only set if it doesn't already exist. However, this approach may still lead to unexpected behavior if other parts of the codebase rely on the default implementation.

issues.description: There is a potential behavioral regression risk because the patch modifies the behavior of how `get_FOO_display()` methods are created. If other parts of the codebase rely on the default implementation, they may stop working as expected.
